headline: LALIGA says an attacker extracted fan data from a platform on Nov 14 to 16. Confirmed by its statement; scale and cause unknown.
summary: New incident page. Sources read: LALIGA's own statement (Tier 1), Reuters via CNA and Europa Press (Tier 2, both relaying that one statement, counted as one source). Cyberattack and data extraction: Confirmed. Dates, containment, regulator and police notices, and scope limits: Reported (company only). Count, data types, attacker and method: Not established. Root cause not published. Privacy check done: no names, handles or contact details.
